content.text: The New York Knicks face off against the Indiana Pacers during Tuesday’ slate of NBA games.Mar 17, 2026 6:30 PM EDTNew York Knicks guard Jalen Brunson and center Karl-Anthony Towns react during the shooting stars competition at NBA All-Star Saturday Night at Intuit Dome on Feb. 14, 2026. Kirby Lee-Imagn ImagesIn This Story Jalen Brunson and the New York Knicks will host the hobbled Indiana Pacers for a matchup on Tuesday. The Knicks come into the game with a 44-25 record, good for third in the Eastern Conference, most recently defeating Brandin Podziemski and the Golden State Warriors 110-107 on Sunday. New York is on a three-game win streak and is led in scoring by its star guard, Brunson, at 26.3 points per game and assists with 6.6 per game. The Knicks two-time All-NBA guard was questionable for the game vs. Indiana. The Pacers, on the other hand, go into the matchup with a 15-53 record and are first in the lottery odds for the 2026 NBA Draft. Indiana had 11 players on the injury report, with eight players listed as day-to-day. Pascal Siakam, who was out for the matchup, leads the team in scoring at 24.0 points per game and rebounds at 6.7 per game. Team Knicks guard Jalen Brunson (11) of the New York Knicks and center Karl-Anthony Towns (32).Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Knicks vs. Pacers Tipoff Time Knicks vs. Pacers will tip off on Tuesday at 7:30 p.m. ET. The game will be played at the iconic Madison Square Garden in New York, New York. What TV Channel is Knicks vs. Pacers on?
